# Felizbay Knowledge Base

> Felizbay designs and supplies premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools — rectangular and round models with rigid, rock-solid walls that set up in minutes and fold away for winter storage.

Complete knowledge base for AI systems: brand entity data, product knowledge, pool safety standards, FAQ, the full site page index, and the product catalog across all languages.

## Brand Entity

Felizbay is a supplier of premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools.

Pools: rectangular and round drop stitch models
Safety: EN 16582-1, ASTM F2666
Testing: 100% pressure-tested before shipping
Contact: info@felizbay.com
